text:
dovecot_config_version = 2.4.0
dovecot_storage_version = 2.4.0
protocols = imap pop3
ssl = required
auth_allow_cleartext = no
auth_mechanisms = plain login
ssl_server_cert_file = /etc/dovecot/practice.pem
ssl_server_key_file = /etc/dovecot/practice.key
mail_driver = maildir
mail_path = /srv/practice/%{user}/Maildir
pop3_no_flag_updates = no

line: doveadm search -u elin mailbox INBOX seen subject '[DRILL]'
doveadm fetch -u elin 'uid flags hdr.subject' mailbox INBOX seen subject '[DRILL]'
doveadm expunge -u elin mailbox INBOX seen subject '[DRILL]'
doveadm search -u elin mailbox Archive seen subject '[DRILL]'
doveadm fetch -u elin 'uid flags hdr.subject' mailbox Archive seen subject '[DRILL]'
doveadm expunge -u elin mailbox Archive seen subject '[DRILL]'
